meta.name: RPSGT V3 ICSD-3-TR Diagnostic Taxonomy
builtFrom: ICSD-3-TR Summary of Diagnostic Criteria Changes (supplemental material)
meta.purpose: Provide a copyright-safe diagnostic concept and change-watch layer for RPSGT study mapping without reproducing proprietary ICSD diagnostic criteria.
meta.copyrightBoundary: Do not store or display complete diagnostic criteria. Store category names, disorder names identified in public/supplemental materials, original SPG concept summaries, change-watch flags, and lawful locators only.
meta.authorityBoundary: ICSD-3-TR controls current diagnostic classification and terminology. The current AASM Scoring Manual controls PSG event scoring; current applicable treatment guidelines control treatment recommendations.
meta.secondaryTaskMappingStatus: needs SME review before learner-facing use

categories.label: Insomnia Disorders
studyTargets: recognize insomnia as a diagnostic family rather than a PSG scoring event
distinguish insomnia symptoms from other sleep, medical, mental-health, medication, or substance contributors
recognize that comorbid sleep disorders may coexist and require differential-diagnosis reasoning

categories.label: Sleep-Related Breathing Disorders
studyTargets: differentiate obstructive, central, hypoventilation, and hypoxemia diagnostic families
separate diagnostic classification from AASM respiratory-event scoring rules
recognize age-specific adult, pediatric, infant, and prematurity considerations
connect PAP-emergent central events with the diagnostic concept of treatment-emergent central sleep apnea without substituting diagnostic criteria for titration rules

changeWatch.changeType: criteria organization and explanatory/exclusion content revised
symptom criteria revised across central-apnea diagnoses

changeWatch.topic: Central Sleep Apnea Due to High-Altitude Periodic Breathing
changeWatch.changeType: diagnostic framing and testing evidence revised

changeWatch.topic: Primary Central Sleep Apnea of Infancy
Primary Central Sleep Apnea of Prematurity

changeWatch.changeType: central-event characterization and associated symptom/sign requirement revised
diagnostic framing expanded beyond a single genetic statement
diagnostic boundary revised to distinguish hypoxemia from hypoventilation and other sleep-related breathing disorders

categories.label: Central Disorders of Hypersomnolence
studyTargets: distinguish narcolepsy, idiopathic hypersomnia, Kleine-Levin syndrome, and hypersomnolence associated with other disorders
connect MSLT/PSG evidence to diagnostic reasoning while using current AASM MSLT/MWT protocols for test performance
recognize that diagnostic classification and test-protocol validity are related but separate source roles

changeWatch.topic: Hypersomnia Associated with a Medical Disorder
changeWatch.changeType: name/criteria content revised from prior edition wording

categories.label: Circadian Rhythm Sleep-Wake Disorders
studyTargets: recognize circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorders as disorders of sleep timing/alignment
use sleep logs and actigraphy as diagnostic-support concepts when appropriate
distinguish disorder classification from actigraphy acquisition/analysis procedures

changeWatch.changeType: sleep-log requirement strengthened and actigraphy support clarified for most CRSWDs

categories.label: Parasomnias
studyTargets: differentiate parasomnia families from nocturnal seizures, movement disorders, and sleep-disordered breathing presentations
recognize that sleep-related urologic conditions were reorganized in the text revision
use clinical history, observation, and appropriate testing context rather than a single PSG signal alone

changeWatch.changeType: sleep enuresis content reorganized and additional urologic sleep diagnoses introduced/defined

categories.label: Sleep-Related Movement Disorders
studyTargets: differentiate movement-disorder diagnoses from scored limb-movement events
recognize sleep-related bruxism and nocturnal muscle-cramp concepts
separate diagnostic classification from AASM movement-event scoring rules

changeWatch.changeType: terminology and diagnostic wording revised from sleep-related leg cramps
behavioral description and associated clinical-feature wording revised

reviewRules: Any question or lesson using an older textbook classification label that intersects a changeWatch topic must be reviewed against ICSD-3-TR before being marked current.
Do not use ICSD-3-TR to override the current AASM Scoring Manual for event-scoring rules.
Do not infer a diagnostic criterion that is not present in a verified current source locator.
Question stems may test recognition, differentiation, testing context, or classification concepts using independently written language; they must not reproduce proprietary criteria verbatim.
Older ICSD-3 and older textbook content may remain as background only when its currency boundary is explicit.
